title: Sort Words by Frequency
prompt: A search page wants popular words first. Write a function that returns each unique word sorted by frequency from highest to lowest. If two words have the same frequency, sort them alphabetically.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Sort Words by Frequency, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A search page wants popular words first. Write a function that returns each unique word sorted by frequency from highest to lowest. If two words have the same frequency, sort them alphabetically. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in JavaScript using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
